name: all-ephemeral-substrate-fuses-like-none
description: A server binding the WHOLE substrate out of stores that declare ephemeral durability keeps no durable record — a restart erases everything — so it MUST fuse exactly like a substrate-less one (#457). Binding is not durability: deriving the NOT_SUPPORTED/NOT_FOUND split from mere binding lets an operator with three in-memory stores promise restorability the deployment cannot deliver, and the promise breaks silently, on the first restart, for every locator at once.
